name: dsh-webpilot
description: WebPilot: a browser that lives inside the DSH host. Every session gets its own Chrome tab, the agent drives it with webpilot_* tools, and a human watches or takes over that same tab in an on-demand right-Sidebar panel with a cyber-spider live-overlay (pilot cursor, click ripples, reading scanlines). Persistent profile means a QR-code login done once works everywhere.
author: frank
